findings.title: Data cleaning improved quality score
findings.statement: The text quality score improved from 71.2 out of 100 before cleaning to 98.7 out of 100 after cleaning, with 14 documents removed in total.
findings.recommendation: Use the cleaned dataset for model training since data quality issues have been largely resolved.

findings.title: Presence of personal identifiable information
findings.statement: Before PII removal, 18 documents or 12.1622 percent of the raw dataset contained personal data such as emails, phone numbers, and card numbers.
findings.recommendation: Ensure that the masked dataset is strictly used for any downstream training tasks to maintain data privacy.

findings.title: Label balance across categories
findings.statement: The cleaned dataset contains 134 documents distributed across billing with 53 documents, shipping with 47 documents, and technical with 34 documents, resulting in an imbalance ratio of 1.5588.
findings.recommendation: Account for the class imbalance during model training by using techniques such as class weights or oversampling to mitigate the 1.56 ratio.

findings.title: Suspected label noise
findings.statement: Code analysis identified 4 documents that are suspected to be mislabeled based on centroid agreement, as they read more like another label.
findings.recommendation: Manually inspect and correct the 4 flagged documents to improve classifier accuracy.

findings.title: Exact and near-duplicates found in raw data
findings.statement: The raw dataset contained 4 exact extra copies and 5 near-extra copies based on MinHash similarity.
findings.recommendation: Keep the duplicate removal steps active in the pipeline to prevent data leakage during cross-validation.

findings.title: Widespread boilerplate confidentiality notices
findings.statement: A repeated confidentiality notice line appeared in 57 documents, representing 38.5135 percent of the raw dataset.
findings.recommendation: Boilerplate removal was successfully applied and verified by the cleaning summary; no further action is required for these segments.

findings.title: Residual encoding damage
findings.statement: The cleaned dataset still contains one document (technical/ticket_tech_036.txt) with encoding damage that was not fully resolved by the fix_encoding step.
findings.recommendation: Manually clean or remove the specific document technical/ticket_tech_036.txt to ensure high-quality training input.

narrative.headline: Support tickets dataset quality improved from 71.2 to 98.7 after cleaning and PII removal.
narrative.executive_summary: Data cleaning successfully increased the quality score of the support tickets dataset from 71.2 to 98.7 out of 100 while removing 14 documents in total. The cleaned dataset contains 134 documents distributed across billing with 53 documents, shipping with 47 documents, and technical with 34 documents, resulting in an imbalance ratio of 1.56. Issues addressed include PII in 12.16 percent of raw documents, boilerplate notices in 38.51 percent of documents, exact and near duplicates, and residual encoding damage in one technical document.
next_steps: Review the 4 documents flagged with suspected label noise based on centroid agreement.
Inspect the single technical document with residual encoding damage at technical/ticket_tech_036.txt.
Address the class imbalance across billing, shipping, and technical categories before training.
Proceed with training the support ticket classifier using the 134 cleaned documents.
